payload.function_structure:
OVERALL FUNCTION: separate the record from the claims at the moment an iteration ends, without losing either.

SUB-FUNCTIONS, verb + noun, solution-neutral:
- F1 capture progress: fix an iteration's intermediate state so it survives the loss of its working place.
- F2 detect emptiness: determine whether an iteration produced anything at all before its ending is honoured.
- F3 name the record: give the iteration's accumulated record a permanent, predictable handle before any of it leaves the shared place.
- F4 classify content: decide, per artifact, whether it is a claim that must stay readable or a record of how the claim was reached.
- F5 combine lines of work: bring the iteration's claims into the shared place while preserving the link back to its full record.
- F6 withhold the record: keep the classified record out of the shared place while keeping it retrievable.
- F7 preserve reachability: guarantee that withheld material can still be produced on request afterwards.
- F8 bind pointer to handle: ensure every reference to withheld material carries enough to find it.
- F9 refuse on doubt: leave the shared place untouched whenever any of the above cannot be completed.
- F10 keep the ended work visible: ensure an ended iteration is still enumerable after its record is withheld.
- F11 equip a working place: ensure a newly created working place can exercise its own checks.
- F12 warn on divergence: signal when a new working place would start from a state that does not match what is running.
- F13 protect the record from erasure: prevent operations that would destroy already-recorded history.
payload.coverage:
REQUIREMENT -> FUNCTION (every requirement maps): R1 -> F1. R2 -> F2, F9. R3 -> F3. R4 -> F3, F9. R5 -> F4, F5, F6. R6 -> F7. R7 -> F8. R8 -> F9. R9 -> F11. R10 -> F12. R11 -> F13. R12 -> F10. Q1 -> F9 (the refusal function is what makes atomicity observable).

USE-CASE STEP -> FUNCTION (no holes): UC-A step 1 -> F2; step 2 -> F3; steps 3-5 -> F4, F5, F6; step 6 -> (worktree retirement, existing, unchanged); step 7 -> F10; ext 1a -> F2+F9; ext 2a -> F3+F9; ext 3a -> F9; ext 4a -> F4 (absent path is simply unclassified, not an error); ext 6a -> existing flag-never-force behaviour. UC-B steps 1-3 -> F1; ext 2a -> F1 (nothing to capture is legal). UC-C steps 1-2 -> F8, F7. UC-D steps 1-3 -> F11, F12.

No function is left without a requirement, and no requirement without a function. F7 and F6 are deliberately separate: withholding and remaining-reachable are different guarantees, and conflating them is precisely how a split becomes a deletion.
